newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Friday August 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Friday August 1.

text.p: The following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.
* Centre-right opposition leader Silvio Berlusconi said his party's alliance with the hard-right National Alliance party stood in the way of a broader political coalition (all).
* National Alliance party leader Gianfranco Fini admitted in an interview that the centre-right opposition was recently facing a leadership crisis (Corriere della Sera).
* A report by national statistics institute ISTAT showed medium and large firms' April retail sales in Italy rose 2.4 percent from a year ago (all).

* Information technology group Olivetti said its consolidated revenues for the first half of 1997 stood at 3.1 trillion lire, down 10.4 percent on the same period in 1996. The group said in a statement following a board meeting that Rodolfo De Benedetti, son of former Olivetti chairman Carlo De Benedetti, had resigned from the board (all).

* Shares in Banco Ambrosiano Veneto rose over three percent to more than 10,000 lire a share on the Milan stock exchange as investors greeted news of the formal signing of its accord with savings bank Cariplo to create a new major banking group. Savings shares in Ambroveneto also closed 5.37 percent higher (all).
* A study by state-funded economic research institute ISCO showed Italy's gross domestic product is likely to have grown in the second quarter of this year compared with the first quarter (all).

* Textiles and apparel group Marzotto said its first half 1997 consolidated net sales came to 1.170 trillion lire, up 6.8 percent compared with the first half of 1996. The group's consolidated operating income was 131 billion lire against 91.2 billion lire previosly (Il Sole 24 Ore).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
